meta.name: init_project
meta.goal: Initialize agentic-os-core on a fresh machine: toolchain, generated agent/MCP config, dependencies, green tests, and a running dev stack.
meta.note: Structure: tasks -> subtasks. Status values: pending / in_progress / done / failed / skipped. On finishing a subtask, set its status and write the result into its note; a task is done when all its subtasks are done (write a short summary in the task note).

T001.1.title: Read project docs and check toolchain
T001.1.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at the repo root. Verify uv, node, npm and make are installed.
T001.1.expect: Versions of uv, node, npm and make are recorded in note.

T001.2.title: Create .env
T001.2.prompt: Copy .env.example to .env if it is missing. Never commit it.
T001.2.expect: .env exists and is gitignored (`git check-ignore .env` prints it).

T001.3.title: Generate agent and MCP config
T001.3.prompt: Run `make agents_sync` and `make mcp`. Edit only under .agents/ and .mcp/servers.json, never the generated files.
T001.3.expect: `make agents_sync-check` and `make mcp-check` report no drift, and `git status` shows no unintended changes.

T002.1.title: Install api and web dependencies
T002.1.prompt: Run `uv sync` in apps/api and `npm install` in apps/web.

T002.2.title: Run tests
T002.2.prompt: Run `make test` from the repo root.
T002.2.expect: api and web tests pass; pass counts are recorded in note.

T002.3.title: Lint and build
T002.3.prompt: Run `cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .` and `cd apps/web && npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build).
T002.3.expect: ruff is clean and the web build succeeds.

T003.1.title: Start the stack
T003.1.prompt: Run `make dev` (api :8000 + web :3000). On macOS, if :3000 is busy, kill the listener by hand first (scripts/free-port.mjs frees nothing on macOS).
T003.1.expect: GET http://localhost:8000/api/health returns OK and http://localhost:3000 responds.

T003.2.title: Check the web app
T003.2.prompt: Open http://localhost:3000 (not 127.0.0.1; OAuth cookies are host-scoped). Check the landing page health readout, /skills and /commands.
T003.2.expect: Landing page shows a live health readout; /skills and /commands list content from .agents/.

T003.3.title: Stop the stack
T003.3.prompt: Stop the dev processes started in T003.1.
T003.3.expect: Nothing is left listening on :8000 and :3000.
